Subject: Your complaint #4821 – resolution and next steps

Dear Ms. Patel,

Thank you for contacting us about the delayed delivery of your order #4821. I understand how frustrating it is when a promised delivery window slips, and I want to assure you that we take this seriously. Our claims assistant reviewed your case and confirmed that the courier misrouted the parcel; a replacement has been dispatched and should arrive by Friday. As a gesture of goodwill, we have also added a 15% discount to your account for your next purchase. If you have any further questions, please reply to this email and we will be happy to help.

Kind regards,
Emma Lawson
Customer Care Team

Subject: Question about my gym membership renewal

Hi Team,

I'm writing to ask about my membership renewal, which is due next month. I was told by the front desk that the price will stay the same if I renew before the 15th, but I wanted to double-check because the app showed a different amount. Also, could you confirm whether the assistant at the front desk was correct about the guest passes being included? I've attached a screenshot of the app for reference. Thanks for your help.

Best,
Jordan Lee
